basic_details.job_title: IPA Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 11 Joint Director, Dy. Director and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Indian Ports Association (IPA), an apex body of Major Ports functioning beside the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, is filling 11 posts in its IT Division on a Fixed Term Employment Contract of 03 years: Joint Director (IT) 1, Dy. Director (IT) 3, Sr. Asst. Director (IT) 3 and Asst. Director (IT) 4. Tentative annual CTC runs from ₹10,16,400 to ₹21,78,000 and the posting is at Mumbai or New Delhi. how_to_apply: Apply online only, through the link provided on the Indian Ports Association website. The notice states that no other mode of application is accepted.
Complete online registration and fee payment between the start date (25.11.2026, tentative) and the closing date (16.12.2026, tentative).
Pay the application processing fee of Rs 400/- per application online, following the instructions on the Application Portal.
Make a separate application for each post if applying for more than one post.
Check the Job Openings/Careers section of the IPA website for further details and updates.

Eligibility is decided on the self-declaration in the online application, without initial verification of supporting documents. No changes to application data are permitted after online registration is completed.

Application fee: Rs 400/- per application, paid online. The notice makes the candidate responsible for additional bank transaction or payment gateway charges and taxes. Fees once paid are non-refundable and non-transferable to other examinations or selections. The notice prints no category-wise fee or exemption.
important_instructions: Candidates found not meeting the eligibility criteria, giving incorrect or false information or withholding material facts are disqualified immediately; if found after appointment, IPA reserves the right to terminate services. Candidates must hold valid mark sheets and certificates proving qualifications as of the closing date. Failure to provide original documents results in immediate disqualification. Academic, teaching or internship experience is not counted as essential experience. Experience must be supported by employer-issued certificates showing designation, period of employment and nature of duties. Where a CGPA or grading system is followed, equivalent percentage is determined by the University/Institution's official conversion formula, with documentary proof at verification. Requests to change post, examination centre, venue, date or session are not accepted. Biometric data may be collected before the examination or document verification. Meeting the eligibility criteria does not confer any right to be called for the examination or interview. IPA reserves the right to modify the selection procedure and examination structure, to cancel, restrict or modify the recruitment process without notice, and to change the designations of the posts. Any form of canvassing leads to disqualification. Disputes are subject to the courts/tribunals having jurisdiction over Delhi. A candidate must submit willingness for the post at the interview and, if selected, must join within one month of issue of the appointment letter.

content_sections.heading: About the Indian Ports Association and its IT Division
content_sections.text: Indian Ports Association is an apex body of Major Ports of India, established in 1966 under the Societies Registration Act. It works to facilitate port development and capacity enhancement through technology upgradation and port connectivity. Its IT Division leads the digital transformation of the Major Ports. Initiatives named in the notice include the Maritime Single Window (MSW) – Sagar Setu, Bharat Port Operating Systems (Bharat POS), the Enterprise Business System (EBS) with ERP, cybersecurity and information security management, the Bharat Maritime Information System (BMIS) and the Sagarmanthan portal.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 11 positions in total (1 + 3 + 3 + 4). It does not give a category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The educational qualification is the same for all four posts: Full-time B.E./B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence (AI), AI and Machine Learning (ML), Data Science, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or Full-time MCA, from a recognised University/Institution, with at least 60% aggregate marks or an equivalent CGPA/grade in the respective qualifying degree. The notice calls this the essential qualification. The crucial date for determining eligibility, experience and age is the last date to apply online, 16.12.2026. The notice prints only an upper age limit for each post and mentions no age relaxation. Essential experience: at least 5 of the 12 years in one or more of (i) implementation, operation or management of enterprise-scale IT applications, ERP systems, digital platforms or integrated information systems; and/or (ii) leadership of IT projects/programmes involving system integration, vendor and contract management, and multi-stakeholder coordination. Desirable qualification: M.E./M.Tech. in Computer Science, AI, Data Science or IT; MBA in IT, Systems Management or Business Analytics; or recognised professional certifications in cybersecurity (CISSP, CISM, CISA, ISO/IEC 27001), IT Service Management (ITIL), Enterprise Architecture (TOGAF), AI/ML, Cloud Computing, Data Analytics or IT Governance. Desirable experience: taking at least three IT projects to production deployment/go-live; leading or managing large-scale digital transformation, enterprise IT, cybersecurity, AI/ML, Digital Twin, data analytics or system integration initiatives, preferably in ports, maritime, multimodal logistics, transport sectors or large public digital platforms. Essential experience: at least 2 of the 6 years in one or more of (i) software application development, system implementation, IT project management; or (ii) deployment of digital technology solutions. Desirable qualification: M.E./M.Tech. in Computer Science, AI, Data Science or IT; MBA in IT, Systems Management or Business Analytics; or recognised certifications in Cybersecurity, ITIL, TOGAF, AI/ML, Cloud Computing, Data Analytics or IT Governance. Desirable experience: involvement in at least two completed IT implementation projects; experience in enterprise applications, ERP, Port Operating Systems, cybersecurity, MSW–Sagar Setu, AI/ML, Digital Twin, IoT, predictive analytics, cloud platforms or data integration, preferably in Government, ports, maritime, logistics or infrastructure sectors. Essential experience: at least 1 of the 4 years in development, implementation, integration, testing or maintenance of enterprise applications, database-driven systems, ERP platforms, cargo/logistics applications or Government digital platforms; or database management using SQL-based relational databases or REST API development/integration, application development and testing, digital platform implementation and technical support.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Pay is a consolidated monthly remuneration of base salary plus flexible allowances. The notice gives the approximate monthly cost to company (CTC) as below. House Rent Allowance: leased accommodation as per IPA's policy, or HRA at 30% of the monthly base salary, may be provided over and above the consolidated remuneration. Performance Linked Increment: up to 10% increase in Base Salary and proportionate enhancement in allowances, based on annual performance review. Provident Fund / Severance Fund: matching contribution at 12% of Base Salary as opted by the candidate (included in annual CTC). Medical benefits as per IPA's Medical Policy; computer/laptop, mobile including recharge and internet facility for official work as per IPA's Contractual Employment policy. Tenure: Fixed Term Employment Contract of 03 years, extendable for a further period subject to requirement and satisfactory performance. Service conditions are governed by The Indian Ports Association Contract Employment Policy, 2025 as amended from time to time.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IPA Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Apply online only, through the link provided on the Indian Ports Association website. The notice states that no other mode of application is accepted. Complete online registration and fee payment between the start date (25.11.2026, tentative) and the closing date (16.12.2026, tentative). Pay the application processing fee of Rs 400/- per application online, following the instructions on the Application Portal. Make a separate application for each post if applying for more than one post. Check the Job Openings/Careers section of the IPA website for further details and updates. Eligibility is decided on the self-declaration in the online application, without initial verification of supporting documents. No changes to application data are permitted after online registration is completed. Application fee: Rs 400/- per application, paid online. The notice makes the candidate responsible for additional bank transaction or payment gateway charges and taxes. Fees once paid are non-refundable and non-transferable to other examinations or selections. The notice prints no category-wise fee or exemption.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is by an online Computer Based Test (objective type) followed by an interview. Candidates are shortlisted for the interview on merit in the online test in a 1:3 ratio (vacancies to candidates). The final score gives 85% weightage to the online test and 15% to the interview. Asst. Director (IT) has a separate examination, 120 minutes in total. Sr. Asst. Director (IT), Dy. Director (IT) and Jt. Director (IT) share one common examination, 120 minutes in total. Selection is based on merit, subject to verification of requisite experience and qualification. The online tests are conducted in English. Each incorrect answer carries negative marking of 1/4th of the marks allotted to that question. To qualify for shortlisting, candidates must achieve minimum overall marks of 40%. IPA reserves the right to adjust the qualifying cut-off marks and limit the number of candidates. Tie-break: the candidate with higher marks in the technical section is preferred; if still tied, the candidate with the higher date of birth (the older candidate) is preferred. Examination centres: Asst. Director (IT) at New Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Guwahati, Indore and Ahmedabad, as specified in the admit cards. The common examination at Mumbai, Delhi, Hyderabad and Kolkata. Dates of the online examination will be intimated around 21 days before the examination. Candidates are not permitted to appear for the online examination without a valid call letter/admit card for the specific date and session, an original photo-identity proof and a photocopy of it. The name must match the admit card exactly. Accepted IDs: Aadhaar/e-Aadhaar, PAN Card, EPIC/e-EPIC, Passport, Permanent Driving License, or any valid Photo Identity Card issued by Central/State Government. At document verification/interview, candidates produce originals and self-attested photocopies of: Document Verification/Interview Call Letter. Valid system-generated printout of the online application form and e-receipt. Proof of Date of Birth (Municipal-issued Birth Certificate or SSLC/Std. X Certificate with DOB). Photo Identity Proof. Mark-sheets and certificates of educational qualifications and relevant eligibility documents for the specific post. Proofs of experience showing the nature of work, duly certified by the employer; private-sector candidates also furnish Form 16 / pay certificate with appraisal reports. For government/quasi-government/Public Sector Undertaking employees: No Objection Certificate from the employer.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 11 positions: Joint Director (IT) 1, Dy. Director (IT) 3, Sr. Asst. Director (IT) 3 and Asst. Director (IT) 4.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IPA IT posts?
faq.answer: The last date for online application is 16.12.2026. Online registration and fee payment are shown as starting 25.11.2026, and both dates are marked tentative in the notice's dates table.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for IPA Asst. Director (IT)?
faq.answer: A full-time B.E./B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering, Information Technology, AI, AI and ML, Data Science, Electronics and Communication Engineering or Electronics Engineering, or a full-time MCA, with at least 60% aggregate marks or equivalent CGPA/grade. No prior experience is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for IPA IT posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 50 years for Joint Director (IT), 40 years for Dy. Director (IT), 35 years for Sr. Asst. Director (IT) and 30 years for Asst. Director (IT), counted as on 16.12.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of IPA Joint Director (IT)?

faq.answer: Selection is by an online Computer Based Test and an interview. Candidates are shortlisted in a 1:3 ratio, and the final score gives 85% weightage to the test and 15% to the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is the IPA IT job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the posts are on a Fixed Term Employment Contract of 03 years, extendable for a further period subject to requirement and satisfactory performance.

faq.answer: Yes, for Sr. Asst. Director (IT), Dy. Director (IT) and Jt. Director (IT) if you meet each post's essential criteria. A separate application is required for each post.
